description: In a world that never stops, what truly matters often whispers. Explore The Noise Paradox with TEDxNITKSurathkal — ideas, people and perspectives that bring clarity to the noise.

registration.message: Registration for The Noise Paradox is open.

stages.name: Distraction
stages.description: An endless stream of information. A thousand things asking for our attention.

stages.name: Overload
stages.description: More voices. More choices. Somewhere in the rush, meaning becomes harder to find.

stages.name: Reflection
stages.description: We pause. We question. We listen closely enough to notice a different perspective.

stages.name: Clarity
stages.description: The noise settles. An idea resonates. A quieter, stronger signal begins to emerge.

faq.question: When and where is the next event?
faq.answer: The Noise Paradox is the next chapter of TEDxNITKSurathkal. The date and specific venue will be announced here once confirmed.

faq.question: How can I register?
faq.answer: Registration details are coming soon. Check this website or our official Instagram for announcements. No ticket prices or booking deadlines have been announced on this site.

faq.question: Who can attend?
faq.answer: TEDxNITKSurathkal brings together curious minds from the NITK community and beyond. Eligibility and admission details for the next edition will be shared when registration opens.

faq.question: Where can I watch talks from past editions?
faq.answer: Visit our Talk Archives to explore talks from previous TEDxNITKSurathkal editions, or browse Past Editions to discover their themes and speakers.

faq.question: How can I partner with the event?
faq.answer: Write to tedx@nitk.edu.in for sponsorship, collaboration and other enquiries. Our organizing team will help you find the right way to get involved.

faq.question: Who should I contact about accessibility?
faq.answer: Please email tedx@nitk.edu.in with your access requirements before making travel plans. The team can confirm the arrangements available for the announced venue.
